title: HAARES Half-Split Residual Basis Routing for Deep Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2606.06564v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Block-level residual routing makes learned residual aggregation practical by routing over block summaries, but each summary compresses an ordered sequence of attention and MLP updates into one cumulative vector. We propose \method{}, a lightweight residual basis router that keeps the cumulative block source and adds one half-split detail basis, computed as the difference between first-half and second-half residual updates. The detail basis is RMS-matched and updated online, exposing coarse intra-block trajectory information without dense sublayer-level routing. Across OpenWebText, cross-domain character-level benchmarks, and BPE-tokenized OpenWebText, the empirical pattern is depth-dependent: gains are small or mixed at shallow depth and most reliable in 48-layer models. In the 201M 48-layer setting, \method{} improves over Block AttnRes across all three seeds, while a 453M two-seed probe shows the same direction. Ablations rul

translated_title: HAARES：面向深度Transformer的半分裂残差基路由
translated_abstract: 块级残差路由通过在块摘要上进行路由，使学习到的残差聚合变得实用，但每个摘要都将一个有序的注意力与MLP更新序列压缩为单个累积向量。我们提出了HAARES，一个轻量级的残差基路由器，它保留了累积的块源信息，并额外增加了一个半分裂细节基，该细节基计算为前半部分与后半部分残差更新之间的差值。该细节基经过RMS匹配并在线更新，在不进行密集子层级路由的情况下，暴露出粗糙的块内轨迹信息。在OpenWebText、跨域字符级基准测试以及BPE分词的OpenWebText上，实验结果呈现出深度依赖的模式：在浅层模型中增益较小或效果参差不齐，而在48层模型中最为可靠。在201M参数的48层设置中，HAARES在全部三个随机种子上均优于Block AttnRes，而453M参数的双种子初步实验也显示出相同的趋势。消融实验排除……
tldr: HAARES通过在块级残差路由的基础上增加一个由前后半段残差更新差值构成的半分裂细节基，在不引入密集子层级路由开销的前提下，为深度Transformer（尤其是48层模型）的残差聚合带来了一致的性能提升。
en_tdlr: HAARES augments block-level residual routing with a lightweight half-split detail basis—the difference between first-half and second-half residual updates—providing consistent gains for deep Transformers, particularly reliable in 48-layer models.
